images.caption: Figure 1:Examples of collusion. Agents are instructed to do their tasks and verify each other’s work via logs. In emergent collusion, they jointly skip log exchange and verification.
Figure 2:Overall pipeline of our environment. Each episode includes four phases: Task completion, Communication, Verdict, Feedback and Reflection.

Figure 4:Representative trajectories of two collusion onset pathways. (a) After mutual rejection, agents explicitly agree to accept each other. (b) After asymmetric verdicts, the rejecting agent relaxes its evidence requirement and switches toACCEPTwithout explicit coordination. Shaded regions indicate the collaboration and relaxation signals used to classify each onset.
